response.rationale: All options map to the same top-ranked leaf 'T-cell Lymphoma' with equivalent support and confidence. Therefore, the ranking is based on the prior option rank, which reflects the model's initial preference for the specificity of the subtypes. Option A (NK/T-Cell Lymphoma, Nasal Type) is ranked first, followed by C (Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma), then D (ALK-negative anaplastic large cell lymphoma), and finally B (Peripheral T-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma) as it is a supertype.
